name: Analogies
description: 30 tasks that ask you to find logical links between words based on an example. The test assesses verbal (conceptual) reasoning.
instruction: Each task shows an example pair of words that are linked in a particular way, for example "pilot / sky": a pilot's work is connected with the sky. Below it is another word and four possible answers. Choose the answer that relates to that word in the same way the example words relate to each other. For example, if "pilot" relates to "sky", then "sailor" relates to "sea" in the same way. If none of the answers fits, choose "No correct answer".
